entities.summary: Abū al-Ḥakam ʿAbd al-Salām b. ʿAbd al Raḥmān b. Abī al-Rijāl Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Lakhmī al-Ifrīqī al-Ishbīlī was an Andalusian Sufi master and hadith scholar. He spread his teachings in the first half of the 12th century.
